notes.title: Next Update: The Emerald City, Main Story & More
notes.content:
[h2]🗞️ [b]NEWS – WHAT’S COMING NEXT?[/b][/h2][p]This week I’ve been writing a lot for the [b]main storyline[/b]. I’ve shared it with a few people, and they [b]loved it[/b]. So I hope it will [b]entertain, move, and inspire[/b] you just as much.[/p][p]Here are a few things I can already reveal:[/p][list][*][p]The story continues from the [b]Purple King’s mission[/b], so you’ll need to work to obtain it. If you already have, [b]destiny will find you[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The heroes will feel the [b]pressure of the world around them[/b]. As they grow closer, [b]they’ll have to choose[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]I’m going to make you [b]suffer[/b], and I hope also [b]laugh and dream[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]Many more adventures are coming, because when this one ends, [b]new paths will open[/b]. Remember: this game [b]never truly ends[/b]. At least not while I live! It’s the [b]project of my life[/b], and I’m narrating a world where [b]eternal beings dwell[/b]. And I’ll take you by the hand into that world—[b]if you wish[/b].[/p][p]📅 So stay tuned for the next [b]update[/b]! I’m working hard on it.[/p][h2]🛠️ [b]OTHER THINGS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The next update will also introduce the [b]foundation of houses[/b], which I’ll refine later. You’ll be able to [b]store your money and belongings[/b] at home.[/p][/*][*][p]I’ll also add [b]weapons and armor with special powers[/b], like [b]fire resistance[/b] and more.[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll have to [b]defeat up to 3 bosses[/b], and they’ll be [b]tougher than the Aberration[/b]. Watch out![/p][/*][*][p]Many features are in development—both in [b]combat[/b] and beyond. Too many to list now. The goal is to expand both [b]depth[/b] (features) and [b]breadth[/b] (size and locations).[/p][/*][/list][h2]🗺️ [b]THE MAPS DLC NOW HAS A NEW ADVANTAGE[/b][/h2][p]The [b]Maps DLC[/b] isn’t required to play. It’s meant as a way to [b]support the development[/b]. But now I’ve added a new perk: [b]maps that show exits between areas[/b], and places that require [b]keys or are blocked[/b].[/p][p]With these new maps, you’ll be able to [b]plan your missions better[/b], and choose your paths more comfortably to reach your goals.[/p][h2]📚 [b]THE BESTIARY[/b][/h2][p]I’ve decided to design it in a [b]style similar to the game[/b], since you’re already familiar with it. It will be an [b]illustrated PDF[/b], with matching background and decorations. It will be a [b]digital DLC[/b].[/p][p]It will contain a [b]catalog of species, cultures, and peoples of the Rift[/b]. Each creature will be described with its [b]traits, strengths, weaknesses[/b], and [b]lore and testimonies[/b].[/p][p]This DLC will be [b]optional and supportive of the development[/b]. I haven’t set the price yet, but it will be [b]moderate and fair[/b].[/p][p]📄 On my blog, you can view and [url="http://www.beautifulfantasy.art/2025/09/preview-of-bestiary-for-caverns-and.html"]download a draft page about the dryads and the Gnomurk[/url]. 💬 Share your thoughts: Is this the kind of bestiary you want? What’s missing? Dark or light background? Would it be useful in .epub format?[/p][p]Comment here, on the blog, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3634870/discussions/0/520850943158326668/"]or in the Community![/url]
[/p][h2]✍️ [b]NOVEL[/b][/h2][p]A medium-term project is the [b]novel[/b]. Both you, my dear adventurers, and beta readers have told me I [b]must turn it into a book[/b].[/p][p]So I’m gradually [b]gathering the story[/b], which I’ll [b]expand and unify[/b]. I may publish the novel. Most likely, I’ll release it here on [b]Steam[/b], as a [b]support DLC[/b].[/p][p]But this is a [b]side project[/b]. The [b]top priority[/b] is the [b]game[/b], then the [b]bestiary[/b]. The novel is forming in parallel, since it’s the [b]game’s stories in book format[/b].[/p][p]📣 Are you excited about the novel? Tell me in the comments! You’ll make me very happy.[/p][h2]🙏 [b]THANK YOU[/b][/h2][p][b]THANK YOU[/b] for playing [i]Caverns and Dryads[/i], adventurer. I hope you enjoy this as much as I do. Stay tuned while I work on this update. I can’t wait to share it with you![/p]

notes.title: Version 1.4, backstory chapters engine
notes.content:
[p][b]Release 1.4 is here![/b] This update introduces new [b]backstory and worldbuilding chapters[/b] that appear in [b]dungeons[/b], [b]cities[/b], and when you [b]rent a room at the inn[/b]. As requested by some players, these additions offer deeper insight into the characters of [b]Tamzyn[/b] and [b]Sioul[/b], as well as the game world itself.[/p][h3]🧭 What are they and what are they for?[/h3][p]These are [b]short narrative chapters[/b] without choices, where you simply [b]witness conversations[/b] between the characters. They reveal [b]important details[/b] for later in the game and help you [b]understand the world[/b] and its inhabitants more deeply.[/p][h3]💞 Relationship Points[/h3][p]Some chapters in [b]dungeons and cities[/b] will grant [b]relationship points[/b], while [b]all chapters at the inn[/b] will give [b]trust points[/b]. These stats will play a role in future story developments and may influence how certain events unfold.[/p][h3]🧠 The Key Concept[/h3][p]The most important part of this update is the new [b]engine[/b] that allows me to add these chapters using [b]images with facial expressions[/b], paired with the writing. This gives the game [b]more emotional depth[/b], while keeping it [b]fun and immersive[/b]. As you can see, the game can now grow in [b]depth[/b] (like this update) or in [b]size[/b] (by adding new places, monsters, or features).[/p][h3]🛠️ What I'm working on now[/h3][p]I’ve been writing chapters for the [b]main quest[/b], which I plan to implement next. I might add some [b]jobs[/b] first—or somewhere along the way. Still deciding. With these new chapters, I believe the [b]main story will feel richer and more meaningful[/b].[/p][p]Stay tuned, and thank you so much for playing in my universe. [b]Enjoy![/b] 😊[/p][p][b]P.S.[/b] I’d love to hear your feedback on the new chapters—especially if you liked them (just being honest, lol).[/p][p][b]Thank you dear adventurers for playing my game. You are making the dream of my life true, by living it with me. I can't thank you enough and I hope you enjoy as much playing as I do creating. - Louis.
[/b][/p][h3]📝 Full Changelog[/h3][p][b]Version 1.4 – September 7, 2025[/b][/p][p][b]MOST IMPORTANT UPDATES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added engine to support [b]backstory / character depth chapters[/b], with [b]character images and expressions[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]new chapters[/b] in cities, wilderness, and inns.[/p][list][*][p][b]Inn chapters[/b] increase [b]trust[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Some other chapters increase [b]relationship stats[/b], but not always.[/p][/*][*][p]These are designed to enhance [b]character immersion[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]OTHER UPDATES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added ability to [b]change music mid-chapter[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where [b]money couldn’t be picked up[/b] if inventory was full (Loot system).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.3.2 bugfix update
notes.content:
Version 1.3.2, August 20, 2025
---------------------------
- Fixed bugs in Blessing and Dryads scenes, so if you reached 18 in a stat, the blessing will go to another stat. If all stats are on 18, you are notified that the gods or dryads can't bless you anymore.
- Fixed bug if you already had learned a spell from a scroll, you can't re-learn it. You will be notified that you can sell the scroll.
- Fix for players that learned the same spell several times, so the extra duplicates are deleted.

notes.title: 1.3.1 bugfix for map and gold on inventory. Important please update
notes.content:
Hi! I made a fix of some bugs. They are quite important, so please update: (if it's on auto it will auto update when you open Steam.

Version 1.3.1, August 19, 2025
---------------------------
AVOIDING PLAYER STUCK
- Fixes on the map: to avoid having players stuck, I've changed some places that were not working good and had no exits or ways to go back.
- The only places that you can't even approach without keys are now 3: Thornworm Ruins (because it is the barrier against the Paranormal Entities), Palace of the Dryads (because it may be a place to expand the map south), and Emerald City (because it may be a place to expand the map north).
- In the rest, if they need a key, you can approach and then, even if you can't enter because you don't have the key, you will be able to skip it and go to another place.
- Mansion of Dreams now connects to Golden Caverns (and to Thornworm if you have the key)
- Arcanopolis not connected to Mansion of Dreams, because being a city, you could travel between these two and boost your stats without any difficulty and that would otherwise ruin the game balance.
- Arcanopolis now connects to Verdant Grotto only.
PLEASE IF YOU FIND YOURSELF SOMEWHERE THAT YOU CAN'T GET OUT, TELL ME!

- Now you can take gold coins in Loot even if you don't have space in your inventory, as they go to gold and not to the backpack.

notes.title: Update 1.3: Procedural missions!
notes.content: [p]Hi adventurers![/p][p]In this update, [b]1.3[/b], I've added the engine for [b]procedural quests[/b]. They are called [b]"jobs"[/b] inside the game.[/p][p]Basically a [b]NPC approaches you[/b] and asks you to do something. They will [b]pay you gold[/b] if you accomplish the mission.[/p][p]If you change your mind and for some reason you don't want to complete the mission, [b]you can quit it[/b]. For that, click on the text of the quests briefings, and choose to quit.[/p][p]Now you will find [b]delivery missions[/b], but I will add more types next. Like [b]defeating special monsters[/b], [b]bosses or sub-bosses[/b], [b]battling witches[/b], [b]rescuing someone[/b], and more.[/p][p]With these missions [b]you will always have something to do[/b].[/p][p]In the meantime [b]I will make more deep and hand made chapters and quests[/b], including the main quests and some core secondary ones. But now you don't have to wait to have missions to do![/p][p]If you would like some kind of mission to be included, [b]please tell![/b][/p][p]So start updating and playing! You will have to [b]save for buying a house[/b] and other things. [b]Have fun![/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]COMPLETE CHANGELOG:[/b] [b]Version 1.3, August, 2025[/b][/p][p][b]MOST IMPORTANT UPDATES:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Procedural quests[/b], called [b]jobs[/b] (trabajos in Spanish, missions in French).[/p][/*][*][p]In cities, you may be hired for jobs. Now, the jobs are about [b]delivering documents[/b] to some other city, but I will add more job types which will include [b]defeating menacing monsters[/b], [b]witches[/b], [b]rescuing someone[/b] or [b]finding someone[/b], and more.[/p][/*][*][p]If you finished the [b]Purple King quest[/b] to save the river of Drozz, [b]Urvhal V may also hire you[/b], and he will pay [b]3 times more[/b] than other people.[/p][/*][*][p]Added chapter to [b]quit a job[/b]. You can quit a job just clicking the quests text and choosing to quit or not.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]OTHER:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some bugs and texts.[/p][/*][*][p]There's a [b]passage between Verdant Grotto and Arcanopolis[/b] now.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buttons and text delay in [b]Fine and Beggars[/b] screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Button for [b]spells on map for Android[/b] is now active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display of [b]spell name when you learn it[/b], for Acid Balll.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Maps DLC Supporter Bonus Pack - And what I'm working on!
notes.content:
[p]Hi adventurers! As requested by some players, [b]I've added a first DLC.[/b] It's [b]not needed to play[/b] or a big thing. It's [b]just the map of the places of the game[/b], in [b]huge[/b] size, for printing or watching in the computer. 
Mostly it's also a [b]supporter[/b] bonus pack. [b]If you wanted to donate[/b] some money to me, [b]this is the way,[/b] and it is great because I will save that money for the materials and things I spend on doing the game.[/p][p]Anyway, don't feel obliged, because there will be [b]more useful DLCs[/b] like the Bestiary coming soon, or the RPG Tabletop version, maybe a novel, and so on. [b]Just by playing you are already making me so happy! [/b]And that's why the main game is free. But if you feel extra grateful for this game, you can get it for the price of a beer and make me even happier, [b]and you get the map, which is a cool fan art item.[/b][/p][p]It will appear soon on the page of Caverns and Dryads, but it's still propagating so if you want to have a look, it's here: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921840/Caverns_And_Dryads__Supporter_Bonus_Pack_Maps_DLC/"][/dynamiclink][b]AND WHAT ARE YOU WORKING ON?[/b] You may ask. Well, I'm now doing this for Caverns and Dryads, to enrich the game:[/p][list][*][p]Add [b]procedural quests[/b] (logic + randomness) of the classic type like rescue, find something, bring something, kill big monsters by demand of a king, destroy witches, etc. The kind of things that Tamzyn and Sioul between quests. [b]This way you will always have something to do.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Add [b]chapters of content of some types: romance, background or situations.[/b] They will mostly introduce you to the personality of the main characters and their culture.[/p][/*][*][p]The chapters may happen [b]in the wilderness, at the cities, inn, bar...[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]There will be [b]two types of chapters[/b] of these kinds: those that are situations that [b]repeat[/b] (with some elections and some "dice rolls" to get a reward or a problem), and others that will be [b]one-time[/b] (more elaborate,  dramatic, written and illustrated and more important for the main story).[/p][/*][/list][p]This may take me some time, and a bit of complications and problems, but not much. After that, the plan is to add some chapters vital for the [b]main story,[/b] which will include a basic cheesy "house" (you will understand). Through the main story, hopefully the relationship of the protagonists will reach higher level, and get this way more advantages, and then houses may be fully added.  

Some have asked about the [b]regions[/b] on the north, that are closed by keys, and some other. They will be opened in quests that I'll add. Don't worry. There are monsters and horrors there that are worth a quest.[/p][p]The [b]keys[/b] will be implemented fully on the next steps when I add the main quest. 
[b]If you want some particular thing or place included, please tell, and I may write it. 

Thanks a lot for playing, and I hope you find the plans exciting! Feel free to suggest anything or ask any doubt! I'm here for you! [/b] [/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes and Plans!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, dear adventurers :)[/b][/p][p]I've fixed several bugs, and [b]one very important one[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Some players managed to complete the [b]Purple King quest[/b] much earlier than expected. It's surprising, since it usually takes days or weeks! However, due to a [b]bug[/b], they didn't receive the achievement… [b]I'm very sorry.[/b] It's now fixed: on your next playthrough, the game will check your progress and award you the achievements [b]“Heroes of Subterranea”[/b] and [b]“Defeating the Aberration.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Are you in [b]Arcanopolis[/b] or nearby? You can now travel to [b]Verdant Grotto[/b], as I’ve opened a new path. [b]Check the map[/b]—it contains visual hints about which places are connected (paths or portals similar to others — [i]hint: look at Subterranea’s portals[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Music no longer stops, the [b]door illustration[/b] has been improved, and the [b]“Cancel” button[/b] in the grimoire is now named [b]“Exit,”[/b] for clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What am I working on now?[/b][/p][list][*][p]More chapters for the [b]main quest[/b] and other essential ones[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]random quest system[/b] to keep the action going[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backstory chapters[/b] to better understand the protagonists and their connection[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When the Purple King quest ends, you’ll see that our heroes are no longer just [b]companions[/b], but [b]friends[/b]. And in future quests, they could become [b]lovers[/b] or something more. They may need a [b]home[/b], so start saving—I'd love to add housing options too.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapters set in [b]inns and town locations[/b] will add new possibilities and encounters.[/p][/*][/list][p]On the blog, I’m writing a post about [b]Sioul[/b] and the [b]magic casters[/b] in the universe. I already published one about [b]Tamzyn[/b] and her personality. Now it's Sioul’s turn. Feel free to read it if you'd like.[/p][p]In a few days, a [b]Maps DLC[/b] will be released. It’s [b]not required to play[/b]—just for those who want a [b]large printable map[/b] to study outside of the game.[/p][p]This DLC also serves as [b]dev support[/b]. If you buy it, you help fund hardware, software, educational materials… or simply show your appreciation. It’s offered at a [b]low price[/b], and [b]you don’t need to purchase it[/b]: the game is and will remain free. Just by playing, you're already giving me great support—[b]thank you so much![/b] Some players asked if they could contribute more, so it’s there for them.[/p][p][b]Other DLCs in the pipeline:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Bestiary[/b] of monsters and creatures[/p][/*][*][p][b]History of the Chasm[/b] (key characters, races, lore...)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interactive Grimoire[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tabletop RPG version[/b] of the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]Long-term novel project[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]All of this will be updated as well, but my priority remains adding [b]features to the base game[/b], which will [b]stay free[/b]. I want everyone to play without barriers, and the extras are just for those who want to dive deeper.[/p][p][b]Please share your ideas in the comments or forums[/b]—I'd love to know what features interest you most and whether these DLC ideas appeal to you.[/p][p][b]Thank you endlessly for playing! I can’t thank you enough for stepping into my world and bringing it to life :)
[/b][/p][p][b]Complete Changelog – Version 1.2.2 (August 3, 2025)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Arcanopolis is now connected to Verdant Grotto[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and incorrect naming[/p][/*][*][p]Added music to scenes that lacked it[/p][/*][*][p]Removed critical error in combat tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “Place of the Woods” lore note not showing[/p][/*][*][p]Removed duplicate grimoire icon in Windows exploration screen[/p][/*][*][p]“Cancel” button renamed to “Exit” in grimoire casting screen[/p][/*][*][p]Improved door illustration (previous version was blurry)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement delivery for players who completed the Purple King quest[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected milestone reward that wasn't working properly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.2 Update: quest of the Purple King!
notes.content: [p][b]EXCITING NEWS![/b] ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][b]A huge THANK YOU, brave adventurers, for playing [i]Caverns and Dryads[/i] and for turning this world of my creation into something alive and truly yours![/b][/p][p]You can now update the game to [b]version 1.2[/b]. This version brings life to the [b]Caverns[/b] and [b]Dryads[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]First quest: The Purple King![/b] [b]Heralds of the Purple King[/b] will look for you as soon as you finish the place you are now, and will require you to visit his court for a quest![/p][/*][*][p]You will face a [b]mission to save the city of Subterranea[/b] and the whole [b]Chasm![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Defeat a very big boss monster![/b] Be careful, keep your potions, prepare to use blade and spells against a monster that can smash an entire army![/p][/*][*][p][b]We will dive deep into Tamzyn's mind[/b]: how she feels, what thoughts put her in a dilemma between her heart and the distance that eternal youth puts to her feelings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decide in the story parts[/b]: what you decide will mean bigger or lesser rewards. Make the best decisions, and the relationship between the heroes will grow. By the end of this, they may progress from partners to friends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Get two amazing weapons and a great armor[/b] to face the big boss monster, once you visit [b]Urvhal the Purple King[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Get a lot of money if you succeed in the quest.[/b] Maybe you can buy a house in the near future with it! ;)[/p][/*][/list][p]We now have a [b]working story engine[/b] with all of this inside story parts: [b]music, sound effects, loot, combat...[/b][/p][p][/p][p]From now on, I will be able to [b]add lots of stories[/b]: in bars, between places, at the inn... I plan to add a lot for background, for diversity in cities and sanctuaries, conversations between our heroes... And there's also now a [b]quest engine[/b], so I can expand the game with more secondary and main stories and quests for our heroes! ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][b]PS:[/b] Please provide me with feedback about the difficulty of the quest. It should be not impossible or too hard, but also not easy. It’s okay if you get killed by the boss monster, but not if it kills you every time. Feel free to post in the Community Discussions![/p][p][/p][p][b]IF YOU ARE CURIOUS, HERE'S THE COMPLETE CHANGELOG:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Change on quest display[/b]: you can have a [b]main quest[/b] and a [b]secondary quest[/b]. You can abandon some secondary ones at any moment (except core stories that need to be done). The main one is tied to the story of the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Internal changes[/b] on [b]Quests and Chapters[/b] to add more features.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine[/b] for dealing with [b]different kinds of chapters and quests[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added mechanism[/b] for [b]multiple reward/punishment[/b] depending on actions chosen in a chapter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added mechanism[/b] for [b]checking stats, relationship and status[/b] from the player to influence the chapters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Modified the combat mechanism[/b] in story chapters to introduce the monster as usual.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added mechanism[/b] to allow for [b]different endings[/b] based on combat or other actions being a victory or failure.[/p][/*][*][p]Now [b]weapons and armors[/b] can be found (and equipped) on [b]loot screens[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b]: giving money for guards’ fines in cities didn’t work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Several bug fixes.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added possibility[/b] of having [b]sound effects[/b] inside chapters, in addition to music.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Different combat music[/b] for chapters, besides the usual for normal fights, and another track for boss monsters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added sound[/b] for [b]titan-type boss monsters.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebuilt many parts[/b] of the chapter engine to [b]add new features and robustness.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shake effect[/b] on boss monster images, [b]fade from red to color[/b] on other monsters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map now has visual hints[/b] that connect some places. Part of the image of a location may resemble another, indicating a possible passage between them. Also look for [b]paths drawn[/b] in the picture![/p][/*][*][p]Now if you die and lose money, you [b]won’t always lose all of it[/b], but a [b]random quantity[/b]. This way, you can't be so unlucky to lose everything in one mistake.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fade-in effect[/b] on monster screens. Bosses have additional effects too.[/p][/*][*][p]There are currently [b]3 types of chapters[/b]: [b]main plot[/b] (ordered, main quest), [b]core[/b] (secondary plot, ordered, secondary quest), and [b]random[/b] (unordered, secondary quests). I still have to implement the third type and how and where it appears so it doesn’t conflict with core ones. Maybe I’ll add [b]ternary quests[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sioul has become hairy[/b] because of plot requirements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some dryads have had their images changed or retouched[/b] to avoid misunderstandings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music added to loot screen.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some monster descriptions fixed.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Exits from Stone Hell to Stairs of Despair were broken.[/b] Fixed those and other nearby blocked exits.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: It's almost ready!
notes.content:
[p]Hi adventurers! ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]This week I finished the art for the game update of the new quest. The programming and story parts are ready, so now I'm going to give it all a  test and [b]hopefully I can make the update public this week![/b][/p][p]This has been quite difficult but now I have a solid engine for adding a lot of content. Once I publish this, I will add a lot of situations to give the game a lot more of background and fun![/p][p]The pic is a part of one of the images of the new story. Yes, she is crying. But don't worry too much, I think you will enjoy the depth added and the story has a good ending, actually.[/p][p]Well, in the case you manage to defeat the very big monster... Purple King knows.ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]PD: You can see this image in full at the Artworks part of the Community (and blog). You may also like to read a post on the character development of Tamzyn at my blog.   [/p][p]Also, [b]I dare you to tell me in comments what do you think that the dandelion seed symbolizes in this image of her below, and why she is crying (here or at the blog):[/b]

[url="http://www.beautifulfantasy.art/2025/07/in-mind-of-dryad-thoughts-about.html"]http://www.beautifulfantasy.art/2025/07/in-mind-of-dryad-thoughts-about.html[/url][/p]

notes.title: What I'm working on and progress
notes.content:
[p]Hi adventurers! :)[/p][p]I've been working hard all the week and the weekend on the game. This is a post to let you know what is being done and how is it going. No public release yet for you, because I still have work to do.[/p][p][/p][p]Basically I had to do a lot of coding to make all the [b]features[/b] in chapters work seamlessly. But now:
[/p][list][*][p] You will be able to fight a [b]BOSS MONSTER.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You will find secondary quests and chapters that play upon some events or places.[/p][/*][*][p][b]I will be able to add lots of content after this,[/b] in the shape of one-time and replayable quests[/p][/*][*][p][b]New weapons will appear in these chapters, and a new armor.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Characters develop a bit more, both on the [b]story[/b] and game.[/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to raise [b]stats[/b] in the chapters added.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]find and equip weapons and armor in loot of chapters.[/b] For example, in this one you can get some useful stuff that the Purple King will give you to embark in your quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special sound effects will play at some points of the chapters.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]And why is it not yet ready? Because I am now working on the artistic part: images and story writing. As soon as I finish it, I'll test a while, and then make the update. It may take me this week or maybe a little more. [/p][p]But just wanted to tell you that I'm working on it! Stay tuned![/p][p]By the way... go explore and try to get as many potions or good weapons you find, as maybe you will need it to defeat the tremendous beast you will have to face ;)[/p][p][/p][p]SOME OF THE CHANGES FOR NEXT RELEASE :[/p][p]---------------------------------------------------[/p][p]- Change on quest display: you can have a main quest and a secondary quest. You can abandon some secondary ones at any moment (except core stories that need to be done). The main one has to do with the story of the game.[/p][p]- Internal changes on Quest and Chapters to have more features.[/p][p]- Engine for dealing with different kinds of chapters and quests.[/p][p]- Added mechanism for multiple reward/punishment depending on the actions chosen in a chapter.[/p][p]- Added mechanism for checking stats, relationship and status from the player to influence the chapters.[/p][p]- Modified the mechanism for combat in a story so it introduces the monster as usual.[/p][p]- Added mechanism to send to different endings if combat or other actions are victory or failure.[/p][p]- Now weapons and armors can be found (and equipped) on loot screens.[/p][p]- Fixed: giving money for guards' fine on cities didn't work.[/p][p]- Several bug fixes.[/p][p]- Added possibility of having sound effects inside chapters, in addition to music.[/p][p]- Different combat music for chapters, in addition to the usual for normal fights, and another one for boss monster.[/p][p]- Added sound for titan-type boss monster.[/p][p]- Rebuild many parts of the chapters engine for adding many features and robustness.[/p][p]- Shake effect on boss monster images, fade from red to color in other monsters.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Coming soon: Secondary quest and boss battle!
notes.content: [p]Hi adventurers! :) I am still working on the main quest chapters of the game, but they may take a long time. So I am [b]adding a shorter quest in this moment[/b], a secondary one, but with many [b]ingredients that you will love![/b][/p][p][b]This will allow me to finish something you can play soon, and try things.[/b][/p][p]This story will be your first mission for our heroes, and the Purple King is the one who contacts them for it. He's the King of Subterranea, the city of the Magic Council. [/p][p]Through this quest, your heroes will [b]get a lot of money, some items, and spells[/b]. It also will allow me to test the features added to the engine like:[/p][list][*][p][b]Battle with boss monsters![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Loot in the middle of a chapter (your heroes find objects or a treasure).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Different rewards depending on what you choose[/b] on the interactive chapters of the stories.[/p][/*][*][p]Development of the [b]relationship stats[/b] of the heroes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Branching[/b] the story if you don't succeed, in a way that it lets you try again but without breaking the story.[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition, it also will contain things that you will love like:[/p][list][*][p]Some [b]fun[/b] [b]moments[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]More [b]insight in the personality of Sioul and Tamzyn[/b] and what they [b]feel for each other,[/b] slowly growing into something more than a collaboration. You will be able to [b]make them grow to more than just companions of adventure.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dramatic[/b] moments.[/p][/*][*][p]Become [b]heroes[/b] of Subterranea, if you succeed.[/p][/*][/list][p]In this story you will delve into one of the most dangerous places of the Chasm, and battle against a powerful huge monster. The [b]Purple King,[/b] if you succeed, will also be one of your [b]allies[/b] in some crucial moments in what's to come.[/p][p]For now, [b]start accumulating money, loot what you can, and be ready[/b] so when I update you can embark on the mission! :) Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Progress so far: I got the chapters and quest engine ready
notes.content:
[p]Hi adventurers! :)
This is to let you know what to expect and where I am. For now I don't have a game update, because [b]what I am doing to create the engine for the many updates that I'll post later! :)[/b]

On the last week and this weekend, I worked intensively until I got the engine for chapters finished. It may have some bugs yet, but it already works![/p][p]So now I am going to do this:[/p][list][*][p]Populate the game with the main story and quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Populate everything with stories and quests in different places, and good and bad events.[/p][/*][*][p]Add secondary quests that you can do or not as you wish.[/p][/*][*][p]Add stories for the interaction and relationship between the heroes.[/p][/*][/list][p]So this way I add more drama, adventure, and depth. Now it's the writing and images part what I have to do, and build it all into the logical pieces that my programming uses.[/p][p]With all this, the world will come to life even more! :)[/p][p]I [b]want the characters to be relatable but admirable, with their virtues and flaws, their vulnerabilities and strengths.[/b] I think many of us [b]miss heroes with which we can identify but still be ideal,[/b] heroic and have greatness. The story also has to be the story of a [b]couple[/b], of their [b]true[/b] love, and the strength to [b]overcome[/b] the problems that separate them.[/p][p]This is the purpose of Caverns and Dryads: have fun, make you feel heroic, have good vibes, and hopeful message. That, and killing a lot of monsters, but also sometimes even make friends with them. Appreciate the beauty in dangerous places. [/p][p]Thanks a lot for your fantastic reviews you left me this week, and for all the participation in the community hub discussions, and for playing it! :) You really make me so happy and encouraged to give you the best I can! :)[/p][p]
PD: the illustration of the advancement is the one I made this week. I posted it in Artworks too.

[b]Feel free to share any thought here, specially about what do you expect of Tamzyn and Sioul to be. How do you see or imagine their personality? It's an amazing topic, we will talk more about it soon.[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Secondary weapons, commerce, and more!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers! Great news! :)

I added a bunch of features to the game! 
You can update now, and enjoy them.
As the list may be boring to read, and it's better to show them,
I encourage you to visit my blog and see:
http://www.beautifulfantasy.art/2025/06/version-111-whats-new-inventory-combat.html

As always, comment on the Discussions here, or on this post, as you wish! I love reading your feedback! :)
The most exciting of all this is that they allow a lot of new things to happen in the game, that I will be developing next! Stay tuned!:) It's exciting to have you on board on this adventure!

--

Here's the list of what's new if yo don't:

Version 1.1.00 - June, 2025
----------------------------
- Now you can BUY AND SELL your loot in the cities' shops!
- New spell on sale on shops of the cities: Acidball!
- New wepon that you can find at cities' shops: ball and chain.
- Now you will be able to buy weapons at shops. No one wants to buy yours, though, because they are used. Maybe at blacksmiths in near future.
- Inventory shows main weapon (equiped) and secondary (not equiped) and you can swap between them clicking on any of them. Also, there's the weapons button to see the main weapon detailed stats.
- You can now swap your weapons in combat and use your inventory in the middle of combat, for drinkingpotions or change your weapon to the one that can harm the monster (or try!)
- Finding a new weapon in the dungeons now lets you choose to swap it with one of your weapons (main or secondary), or just continue walking.
- You can now re-enter the city in which you are in, without having to leave. Money is the only limitation for you there.
- Changed the icon on Windows for settings from a musical note to a cog, that is more conventional.
- Minor bugs.

notes.title: Added loot after combat !!!
notes.content:
[b]Hi adventurers![/b]

In this new 1.0.17 version, I added loot after combat!

You can find loot or not, and be more or less, depending on monster's level and strength, place, and wizard's power (a kind of luck), and the kind of items depend on monster's fauna. 

For that I created 24 objects that may appear. Some restore an amount of mana, others amounts of life, and most of them have more or less selling value in gold.

For selling them you will have to wait till next update. Next thing I'll do is to change the shops at the  cities so you can sell your stuff and buy other things :)

[b]But for now, you can go, combat monsters and get loot! :)[/b]

An advice: if you get items that are not to cool, like the bone, it may be a good idea to drop them if you find better loot like the jewels or emeralds.

ANOTHER THING: at some point I will also add the possibility of having a house and store the things you get in more quantities. But for having a house, you will have to grow the relationship between your heroes ;) ""But that is another story and shall be told another time." (= another update :D)

notes.title: Version 1.0.14 with story engine and inventory
notes.content:
Version 1.0.14 - May, 2025 
--------------------------
- Bug fix: player states like poisoned or paralyzed, etc may be added several times and didn't were removed by the spell cure on one attempt. Now it's fixed and states won't be duplicated.
- Optimization: Added methods to deal with several parameters of the player in a more solid way.
- Created the details of the game that register the relationship between the heroes and their milestones in the game.
- Fixed a typo in French.
- Added description of the relationship of the heroes in the Heart screen.
- Now the game has support for growing the relationship through the stories.
- The inventory of object has been implemented to add support for keys, objects on quests, and other objects. 
- Added an apple as object to the inventory that you carry. Use it to recover 5 life points and use it two times. I will add more objects to the game in different places, but this is just to test.
- On combat, the real life points of monsters are displayed, so when I add the boss monsters you feel more frightened by the difficulty of beating them.
- Added color to the number to guess in doors, so you see more clearly if the max is 10 or 50.
- Added back button in tutorial so you can re-read it easier without going to menu.
- Tutorial stories appear now before you enter some situations for first time (only), like combat and on others. This way you can learn as you play, although the tutorial is recommended too.
- Added functions to the story engine to get armors, keys, weapons, story milestones, and more.
- Added the possibility of confronting a special enemy in the middle of a story.
- Message when game starts that reminds you to play the intro story on the menu.
- Tutorial chapter on the first combat that tells you some strategy.
- Tutorials for magic, cities, sanctuary, and worldmap.

notes.title: Thank you! What I'm doing now, and new features suggestions
notes.content:
Hi dear adventurers!
This is just a post to quickly tell you:

- Caverns and Dryads is getting wishlists and some people already joined the Hub Community, so [b]I am incredibly happy and grateful for you to come into my world![/b]

- I am now in the thinking phase of the next features of the game. I found that many of them need the story framework (same that the intro story uses) to be developed in more depth. Why? Because it opens the gate to add the [b]boss monsters, keys, inventory, relationship milestones between the protagonists, drama...[/b] SO MANY things. All of them need it to some degree. 

- I will start implementing the story framework from simple to complex features, so we see new features soon, and then go adding more complex ones. I think it's the best way for me to do and for you to start enjoying the possibilities it opens.

- Suggest your features in the Discussions of the Hub! Here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3634870/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3634870/discussions/[/url]

For example: things that you may love to be added to stories so they can happen. But there are several threads open where you can suggest things. In the way I find they fit the game, I will add them at some point.

Remember that there is also an Artwork section where I will post some image, but you can post too, sending images you do of fanart of the game (all arts welcome:  generative / AI / traditional / digital...).

[b]Thanks again for joining! :) Seeing people enjoy this journey fills me with joy and makes me feel very encouraged to give the best of me! :)[/b]

- Louis.
